channel.title: Plooshi – New Kids Songs
channel.description: New sing-along songs, nursery rhymes and lullabies from Plooshi.

item.title: Johnny Johnny Yes Papa 👶
item.description: Johnny Johnny? Yes Papa! Eating sugar? No Papa! 👶🍬 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most popular and funny nursery rhymes for kids! “Johnny Johnny Yes Papa” is the classic call-and-response song about a little kid who gets caught sneaking sugar from the kitchen. Are you eating sugar? No Papa! Telling lies? No Papa! Open your mouth... HA HA HA! Busted! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EGZg1s8H9-U

item.title: Simon Says 🤪
item.description: Simon says... get ready for the silliest game EVER! 🤪🎶 Play along with Plooshi in this hilarious, high-energy Simon Says song for kids! “Simon Says” turns the classic kids game into a nonstop dance party of silly actions, funny faces, and crazy moves. Touch your nose, stick out your tongue, wiggle like a snail, roar like a dinosaur, and freeze like a statue with spaghetti arms. Can you keep up with everything Simon says? Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w1Xo5W231H4

item.title: One Man Went to Mow 🌾
item.description: One man went to mow, went to mow a meadow! 🌾🐕🎶 Count up with Plooshi in this fun, classic counting song for kids! "One Man Went to Mow" starts with one man and his dog heading out to mow a meadow, and with every verse another person joins in. By the end, eight men and one very busy dog are all mowing together! Kids love the challenge of listing everyone back in order as the chain gets longer and longer. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3RQowO5YZv4

item.title: Learn ABCs with Affirmations 🌟
item.description: This song is about YOU and how amazing you are! Look in the mirror and repeat after me... I am AWESOME! 🌟💪 Sing along with Plooshi and learn your ABCs through powerful positive affirmations! "Learn ABCs with Affirmations" teaches the alphabet while building confidence, self-esteem, and a positive mindset in kids. Every letter comes with a beautiful affirmation your child can say out loud and believe in their heart. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Ssfji-Kay0

item.title: Humpty Dumpty 🥚
item.description: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall, Humpty Dumpty had a great fall! 🥚🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most famous nursery rhymes of all time! "Humpty Dumpty" tells the classic tale of a silly egg who sat on a wall, took a great tumble, and not even all the king's horses and all the king's men could put him together again. Kids love the dramatic fall and the funny ending every single time! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mWMdxmecd8

item.title: Five Little Ducks 🦆
item.description: Five little ducks went swimming one day, over the hills and far away! 🦆🎶 Count down with Plooshi in one of the most beloved counting songs for kids! "Five Little Ducks" follows five little ducklings who go swimming over the hills one by one, and each time Mother Duck says quack quack quack quack, one fewer comes back. But don't worry, the happy ending brings all five little ducks home! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4rmlcyCGmo

item.title: Five Little Speckled Frogs 🐸
item.description: Five little speckled frogs sat on a speckled log, eating some most delicious bugs, yum yum! 🐸🎶 Count down with Plooshi in one of the most popular counting songs for kids! "Five Little Speckled Frogs" follows five cute frogs sitting on a log, munching on bugs, and jumping one by one into the cool pool until there are no green speckled frogs left. Kids love watching the number go down with every splash! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u73Vhgm2aQk

item.title: The Strawberry Song 🍓
item.description: Shake shake berry shake, watch your strawberry dance break! 🍓🎶 Get ready to shake, bounce, and dance with Plooshi in this fun, fruity sing along song! "The Strawberry Song" takes kids on a trip to the garden to pick fresh strawberries, wash them up, and do the berry dance break. Red and sweet with tiny seeds, growing close to garden weeds, pick them when they're ripe and red, that's what grandma said! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DgE_Bv1xFFk

item.title: Somewhere Over the Rainbow 🌈
item.description: Somewhere over the rainbow, way up high… 🌈🌙 Dream along with Plooshi to one of the most beautiful and magical songs ever written. "Over the Rainbow" is a gentle, soothing lullaby about dreaming big, believing in a magical place where skies are blue, troubles melt like lemon drops, and the dreams that you dare to dream really do come true. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fx3xRBRdWkE

item.title: Boot Scoot Boogie Bug 🤠
item.description: Hey there little buckaroos, gather around the barn! 🤠🐛 Put on your cowboy boots and dance along with Plooshi! "Boot Scoot Boogie Bug" is a hilarious, high-energy country dance song for kids about a tiny bug in cowboy boots who is kicking up dust and dancing up a storm. Stomp your boots, wiggle your toes, clap your hands, and yee haw! This silly bug is twirling and hopping and he's not stopping! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TIO5MdaMah8

item.title: The Big Ship Sails 🚢
item.description: The big ship sails on the alley alley oh, the alley alley oh, the alley alley oh! 🚢🎶 All aboard! Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most fun and classic sea shanty nursery rhymes for kids! "The Big Ship Sails" takes little ones on a nautical adventure with a big ship, a brave captain, and a dramatic journey to the bottom of the sea. The catchy "alley alley oh" chorus is so fun to sing that kids won't be able to stop! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6_q_hT79hZw

item.title: The Excavator Song 🚜
item.description: Big arms swinging left and right, digging holes with all our might! 🚜🎶 Dig along with Plooshi in this high-energy construction song for kids! "The Excavator Song" celebrates the biggest, strongest digger on the construction site. Watch the excavator scoop dirt, fill trucks with loads of clay, roll through mud and sand, and dig trenches deep and wide. Dig, dig, watch us go, up and down, high and low! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ghk1IqlkeIY

item.title: Wash Away Germs Song 🧼
item.description: Wash away germs, wash away germs, with soap and water a bubbly firm! 🧼🫧 Scrub along with Plooshi in this fun, catchy hand washing song for kids! "Wash Away Germs" teaches toddlers and preschoolers the correct way to wash their hands, from rubbing and scrubbing every finger and thumb to singing for 20 seconds and drying with a clean towel. Make those bubbles nice and high and say bye bye to germs! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROXw6hbUheE

item.title: Goodnight Sweetheart 🌙
item.description: Goodnight sweetheart, well it's time to go… 🌙💤 Wind down and drift off to dreamland with Plooshi and this beautiful, soothing version of the classic "Goodnight Sweetheart." This gentle lullaby is the perfect way to end the day, with soft melodies and sweet loving lyrics that help your little one feel safe, cozy, and ready for sleep. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChV6cbNYzTM

item.title: The Shapes Song 🔵
item.description: Shapes, shapes everywhere, in our world they love to share! 🔵🎶 Sing along with Plooshi and learn all about shapes! "The Shapes Song" teaches toddlers and preschoolers how to identify circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, and diamonds by counting their sides and corners. Circle's round like the sun, square has four equal sides, triangle points up so high, and rectangle stretches wide like a door. Shapes are everywhere once you start looking! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bxp4DY2OfNg

item.title: The Baseball Song ⚾
item.description: Baseball, baseball, America's game! Hit the ball, swing with no shame! ⚾🎶 Step up to the plate and sing along with Plooshi! "The Baseball Song" is a fun, high-energy sports song for kids that celebrates America's favorite pastime. From swinging the bat and running the bases to pitching strikeouts and hitting home runs over the fence, this song covers all the best parts of the game. Baseball, baseball, makes us proud! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2g5Z6zA8xXo

item.title: The Football Song 🏈
item.description: Quarterback throws the ball so high, wide receiver makes the catch! 🏈🎶 Get ready for game day with Plooshi! "The Football Song" is a fun, high-energy sports song for kids that teaches little ones all about football. From quarterbacks and wide receivers to running backs and touchdowns, this song covers all the action on the field. Score, score, touchdown time! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3vCjSUcJHwI

item.title: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow 🎉
item.description: For he's a jolly good fellow, for he's a jolly good fellow, which nobody can deny! 🎉🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most famous celebration songs in the world! "For He's a Jolly Good Fellow" is the ultimate song for making someone feel special. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, a big achievement, or just telling someone how awesome they are, this classic sing along is the perfect way to cheer them on! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cs8GCn_1QA0

item.title: Brushing Teeth Song 🪥
item.description: Brushing teeth, do do do do do do do! 🪥✨ Grab your toothbrush and sing along with Plooshi in this fun, step-by-step brushing teeth song for kids! "Brushing Teeth" makes oral hygiene fun and easy for toddlers and preschoolers by walking them through every step of brushing, from grabbing the paste to rinsing it out. The super catchy "do do do do do do do" chorus will have your kids actually WANTING to brush their teeth! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ELA8nDMyQH8

item.title: Monster Truck 🚛
item.description: Monster truck, do do do do do do do! 🚛💨 Rev your engines and sing along with Plooshi in this high-energy monster truck song for kids! "Monster Truck" takes the catchiest sing along format ever and puts it on four giant wheels. Big wheels, mighty jumps, loud engines, muddy tracks, and going FAST. If your kid loves trucks, cars, and things that go VROOM, this song is about to be on repeat for the next month! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7K8P6mCaFm0

item.title: Ring Around the Rosie 🌹
item.description: Ring around the rosie, a pocket full of posies! 🌹🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most classic and fun circle game songs for kids! "Ring Around the Rosie" gets toddlers and preschoolers holding hands, walking in a circle, and waiting for the best part... ASHES ASHES, WE ALL FALL DOWN! The big tumble at the end is guaranteed giggles every single time! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Qr2M5nH7Tg

item.title: Sleep Baby Sleep 💤
item.description: Sleep baby sleep, close to my breast, angels are watching love while you're at rest… 💤🌙 Drift off to dreamland with Plooshi and this beautiful, gentle lullaby. "Sleep Baby Sleep" is a soft, tender bedtime song for parents and little ones to share together. With soothing melodies and sweet lyrics about angels watching over, tender lullabies, and dreaming until the morning sun, this is the perfect song to end the day with love. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MKazhB7Ib1Y

item.title: Frere Jacques (Are You Sleeping) 🔔
item.description: Frere Jacques, Frere Jacques, dormez-vous, dormez-vous? Are you sleeping, are you sleeping, Brother John? 🔔🌙 Drift off to dreamland with Plooshi and one of the most beautiful lullabies in the world! This gentle, soothing version of "Frere Jacques" (also known as "Are You Sleeping, Brother John") is perfect for bedtime, naptime, and quiet calming moments. The soft melody and peaceful visuals create a warm, cozy atmosphere that will help your little one relax and fall asleep. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xzepzIHLKRc

item.title: Alice the Camel 🐪
item.description: Alice the camel has five humps, Alice the camel has five humps, so go Alice go! 🐪🎶 Count down with Plooshi in this hilarious counting song for kids! "Alice the Camel" starts with five humps and counts all the way down to zero. But wait, if Alice has no humps... Alice is a HORSE! Of course! The surprise ending gets a big laugh every single time! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xSRBx8EFkuA

item.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep 🐑
item.description: Baa baa black sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full! 🐑🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the most classic and beloved nursery rhymes for kids! "Baa Baa Black Sheep" is a timeless sing along song about a friendly sheep with three bags of wool, one for the master, one for the dame, and one for the little boy who lives down the lane. Simple, sweet, and impossible not to sing along to! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-eE2NQhOOw

item.title: The Counting Song 🔢
item.description: One little bird in the tree, two shiny stars that we can see! 🔢🎶 Count along with Plooshi and learn your numbers from 1 to 10! "The Counting Song" makes learning to count fun and easy for toddlers and preschoolers. Every number comes with something exciting to count, from tweeting birds and shiny stars to bright flowers, balloons, and sweet candies in a jar. Count your fingers, count your toes, count your pencils in a row! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jTQVk9qH3OM

item.title: The Shapes Rap Song 🔷
item.description: Yo, let's learn shapes, it's a rap attack! 🔷🎤 Get ready to learn your shapes with Plooshi in this high-energy shapes rap for kids! "The Shapes Rap Song" teaches toddlers and preschoolers all about circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, ovals, diamonds, stars, and hearts with a fun hip-hop beat that makes learning shapes impossible to forget. Circles round like a pizza pie, squares got four sides touch the sky! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_qTZNB8IsfM

item.title: Learn ABCs with American Pride 🇺🇸
item.description: Yo, let's learn our ABCs with a groove that moves! 🇺🇸🎶 Sing along with Plooshi and learn the alphabet through iconic American landmarks, foods, and culture! "Learn ABCs with American Pride" is a high-energy educational alphabet song for kids that takes little ones on a coast-to-coast road trip from A to Z. From apple pie and baseball to the Statue of Liberty and Yellowstone, every letter celebrates something uniquely American! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XO8gYjqN3Cg

item.title: Splish Splash Bath Song 🛁
item.description: Splish splash, I'm taking a bath! Soapy bubbles and rubber ducky, that's the path! 🛁🫧 Make bath time the best time with Plooshi! "Splish Splash Bath Song" is a fun, bubbly sing along song that turns every bath into a party. Wash your hair, scrub your toes, play with your boat, and sing along while you get squeaky clean. Rub a dub dub in the tub with glee! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ImyhPzpwSw8

item.title: Do Your Ears Hang Low 🐰
item.description: Do your ears hang low? Do they wobble to and fro? 🐰🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the silliest and most fun action songs for kids! "Do Your Ears Hang Low" gets toddlers and preschoolers giggling, wiggling, and grabbing their ears as they sing along to this classic playground favorite. Can you tie them in a knot? Can you tie them in a bow? There's only one way to find out! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cCcXhvTj7NA

item.title: Hot Cross Buns 🍞
item.description: Hot cross buns, hot cross buns, one a penny, two a penny, hot cross buns! 🍞🎶 Sing along with Plooshi to one of the simplest and most classic nursery rhymes for kids! "Hot Cross Buns" is a fun, catchy sing along song about freshly baked treats that has been a children's favorite for generations. With only a few easy words, it's one of the first songs toddlers and preschoolers can learn to sing all by themselves! Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eSNBW8cOsu8
